# Reddix

> AI-powered Reddit lead intelligence for SaaS founders, agencies, and growth teams. Manual scans surface real buying intent on Reddit so you can join conversations warm — not cold.

Reddix turns Reddit into a qualified lead source. You run a manual scan, the AI Intent Scanner pulls fresh threads from subreddits relevant to your product, the Qualification Engine scores buying intent on a 0–100 scale (hot, warm, research, low), and the AI Copilot drafts short, human-sounding replies you review and post yourself. Saved leads live in a persistent CRM. No autopilot, no auto-posting, no background polling — every action is initiated by you.

## Core Features

- **Intent Scanner** — Manual, on-demand scans of your monitored subreddits using Firecrawl + Gemini
- **Qualification Engine** — Two-pass scoring (0–100) with strict intent thresholds: hot, warm, research, low
- **Lead CRM** — Persistent saved leads, status lifecycle, notes, and triage from the scanner feed
- **AI Copilot** — 3-variant reply generation (Direct, Story, Expert), 120–250 chars, auto-appended product URL
- **Subreddit Discovery** — AI analyzes your product profile and suggests the most relevant communities to monitor
- **Onboarding Intelligence** — Firecrawl scrapes your site, OpenRouter extracts product context for sharper targeting
- **Achievement Badges** — Engagement milestones to track your Reddit growth motion
- **Billing** — $150 Lifetime or $45/month Premium via Stripe; all sales final

## Who It's For

- SaaS Founders finding users actively searching for their category
- Marketing Agencies scaling Reddit lead gen across clients
- Solopreneurs running a one-person growth motion
- Developer Tool teams reaching devs where they hang out
- E-commerce Brands surfacing product recommendation threads
- B2B Sales Teams catching enterprise buying signals
- Content Marketers finding content gaps and distribution
- Startup Growth teams building early traction authentically
